name: paper_pseudo_ocv_discharge
description: Stage 0: pseudo-OCV C/20 discharge for electrode balancing / OCP check
comment: Select the cell at launch. C/20 discharge from full charge to the selected cell's min_v; 25h safety ceiling. Precondition: fully charge the cell and rest >=1h. Sampling every 30s is sufficient for the slow OCV sweep. For NMC/NCA, this discharge pass is normally sufficient. For LFP, also run 01b_pseudo_ocv_charge.json from the discharged state and average the two curves to reduce hysteresis.
